items.title: Elon Musk got really awkward at Tesla’s Argentina launch.
items.summary:
The CEO joined the live event via video in Buenos Aires, with President Javier Milei on stage, only to immediately freeze up, make exaggerated facial expressions, and repeat, “I don’t really know what I want to say,” for about two minutes before hanging up.

items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克（Elon Musk）在特斯拉在阿根廷的发布会上非常尴尬。
items.summaryZh: 这位首席执行官通过视频参加了在布宜诺斯艾利斯举行的现场活动，总裁哈维尔·米利（Javier Milei）在台上，但他立即僵住了，做出了夸张的面部表情，并在挂断电话前重复了大约两分钟，“我真的不知道我想说什么”。

items.title: Tesla launches FSD v15, targets its biggest weaknesses, from signs to potholes
items.summary:
Tesla has started rolling out “Full Self-Driving” v15, and its list of improvements reads like a list of FSD’s biggest current weaknesses: sign detection, potholes, and speed handling in school zones.



Tesla also claims “25x better handling of safety critic…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉推出FSD v15，针对其最大的弱点，从标志到坑洼
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉已经开始推出“全自动驾驶”v15，其改进清单就像消防处目前最大的弱点清单：标志检测、坑洼和学校区域的速度控制。

items.title: Tesla Cybertruck’s already impressive turning radius gets even tighter
items.summary:
Tesla is rolling out an update that makes the Cybertruck turn even tighter, improving on what was already one of the best turning radiuses you can get in a full-size pickup.



But there’s a catch. It only works on 2027 model year Cybertrucks, and Tesla plans…
items.titleZh: 特斯拉Cybertruck已经令人印象深刻的转弯半径变得更加紧凑
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉正在推出一项更新，使Cybertruck转弯更紧，改进了全尺寸皮卡中已经可以获得的最佳转弯半径之一。

items.title: Cursor may drop Chinese AI models as India’s Sarvam starts selling them
items.summary: ‘We haven’t changed our motto,’ says Sarvam, as Cursor may drop Chinese AI models over geopolitical risk and India debates DeepSeek.
items.titleZh: Cursor可能会放弃中国的人工智能模型，因为印度的Sarvam开始销售它们
items.summaryZh: Sarvam说，我们没有改变我们的座右铭，因为Cursor可能会因为地缘政治风险而放弃中国的人工智能模型，而印度则在辩论DeepSeek。

items.title: Electric cars are finally mainstream in GTA 6, and Vice City is full of them
items.summary:
Electric vehicles have finally gone mainstream in Grand Theft Auto. In GTA 6, EVs are just part of everyday traffic in Vice City, from Tesla and Porsche lookalikes to a parody of Electrify America’s charging network.



It’s a big change for a series that spe…
items.titleZh: 电动汽车终于成为GTA6的主流，Vice City到处都是电动汽车
items.summaryZh: 电动汽车终于成为侠盗猎车手的主流。在《GTA 6》中，电动汽车只是Vice City日常交通的一部分，从特斯拉和保时捷的仿制品到对Electrify America充电网络的模仿。

items.title: Redwood Materials found a very practical use for AI: Sorting old batteries
items.summary: Tesla cofounder JB Straubel's Redwood Materials says its AI-powered sorting line identifies old batteries with more than 98% accuracy.
items.titleZh: Redwood Materials发现了人工智能的一个非常实用的用途：对旧电池进行分类
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉联合创始人JB Straubel的红木材料公司表示，其人工智能驱动的分拣线能够以98%以上的准确率识别旧电池。

Tesla officially launched in Argentina on Friday with President Javier Milei on stage in Buenos Aires, and Elon Musk joined by video from his plane to welcome the brand’s newest market. It didn’t go well.

items.titleZh: 埃隆·马斯克在尴尬的特斯拉阿根廷发布会上僵住了：“我不知道该说什么”
items.summaryZh: 特斯拉于周五在阿根廷正式推出，总裁哈维尔·米莱在布宜诺斯艾利斯的舞台上亮相，埃隆·马斯克在飞机上通过视频加入，欢迎该品牌的最新市场。事情进展得不太顺利。

items.title: Hollywood Needs a New Pixar
items.summary: AI is accelerating culture’s move to YouTube, Roblox, and TikTok. Movie studios can make the move that transformed Disney.
items.titleZh: 好莱坞需要一个新的皮克斯
items.summaryZh: 人工智能正在加速文化向YouTube、Roblox和TikTok的转移。电影制片厂可以采取改变迪士尼的举措。

items.title: Google told schools to accept AI or lose Search. Now 3 of America’s 4 largest districts are pushing back
items.summary: Chicago, New York and Los Angeles have restricted student AI. Now Google says keeping Search means accepting AI Overviews, and Miami-Dade, a Gemini partner, isn’t saying how it will respond.
items.titleZh: 谷歌告诉学校要么接受人工智能，要么放弃搜索。现在，美国4个最大的地区中有3个正在反击
items.summaryZh: 芝加哥、纽约和洛杉矶都限制了学生的人工智能。现在谷歌表示，保留搜索意味着接受人工智能概览，而双子座的合作伙伴迈阿密戴德并没有说它将如何回应。

items.title: Nations at UN talks on AI killer robots agree to more talks but no firm commitment to rein them in
items.summary: Efforts to establish rules for AI-powered killer robots and drones have run aground. U.N.-backed talks in Geneva ended Saturday with an agreement to extend discussions for two more years.
items.titleZh: 参加联合国人工智能杀手机器人谈判的国家同意进行更多谈判，但没有明确承诺控制它们
items.summaryZh: 为人工智能驱动的杀手机器人和无人机制定规则的努力已经搁浅。联合国支持的日内瓦会谈于周六结束，双方同意将讨论再延长两年。
